adjudication.rationale: In `basePath(store, type)`, the diff changes the check to `ADMIN_MODELS.indexOf(type.replace('_', '-')) !== -1`. In JavaScript, `String#replace` without a global regex only replaces the first underscore, so a type like `some_admin_model_type` would become `some-admin_model_type` and fail to match an `ADMIN_MODELS` entry like `some-admin-model-type`, causing the adapter to use the non-admin base path. The diff doesn’t show any current `ADMIN_MODELS` entries with multiple underscores, so it’s not a present defect, but it is a real, diff-grounded edge case introduced by this change.
